strategy.label: top-down model, deliberately incomplete: adipic acid by the polycondensation equation; the diamine has no dataset in BAFU-2026
strategy.note: NOT S1, and not complete either - read this before using the node. No report in the bundle prints an inventory. The dataset's ecoSpold technology field names both monomers - 'production out of hexamethylene diamine and adipic acid' - and the polycondensation equation gives both amounts exactly: Polycondensation: C6H10O4 (adipic acid, 146.142) + C6H16N2 (hexamethylenediamine, 116.208) -> -[C12H22N2O2]- (nylon-6,6 repeat unit, 226.320) + 2 H2O (36.030); 262.350 = 262.350. Per kg of nylon 6,6: 146.142/226.320 = 0.64573 kg of adipic acid and 116.208/226.320 = 0.51347 kg of hexamethylenediamine, releasing 0.15921 kg of water. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990. Only one of the two can be linked: 'Adipic acid, at plant' [RER] is a real 7-input BAFU unit process, but BAFU-2026 contains no hexamethylenediamine dataset at all, and no adiponitrile or hexanedinitrile either - searched by name over all 11,947 datasets. So this model carries 0.646 kg of the 1.159 kg of monomer the reaction needs, i.e. 56 % of the input mass and none of the nitrogen; the missing 0.513 kg of diamine is not a rounding gap but half the chemistry, and it is why the flow agreement of this node must not be read as a quality statement about the method. It is published rather than withheld because the adipic-acid half is exact and because the missing half is named, quantified and traceable: anyone who adds a hexamethylenediamine dataset can complete it by adding one line.

evidence.where: Cumene / Ethyl benzene / Phosgene / Aniline, at plant [RER]
evidence.note: BAFU template, not a report figure. Every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU-2026 carries the same five-line utility block: 0.333 kWh of 'Electricity, medium voltage, production ENTSO-E, at grid', 2.0 MJ of 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' [CH], 4.0E-10 units of 'Chemical plant, organics', and transport at 0.6 tkm rail + 0.1 tkm lorry per kilogram of precursor. Verified exchange by exchange on Cumene, at plant (0.684 kg benzene + 0.369 kg propylene = 1.053 kg of precursor -> 0.632 tkm rail, 0.105 tkm lorry), Ethyl benzene, at plant (1.030 -> 0.619 / 0.103), Phosgene, liquid, at plant (1.040 -> 0.624 / 0.104) and Aniline, at plant (1.352 -> 0.814 / 0.136). That is the named template this amount comes from.

node.name: Nylon 66, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: Polycondensation step, per kg of nylon 6,6 - MISSING the 0.513 kg of hexamethylenediamine, which BAFU-2026 has no dataset for. The transport lines are sized on the full 1.159 kg of monomer the reaction needs, not on the 0.646 kg that could be linked, so at least the logistics are not understated. The eight waste-treatment services that the BAFU dataset already carries as explicit exchanges are deliberately not part of this model - they were never collapsed away - following the committed PlasticsEurope specs. The consequence, measured in results/checks/, is that the target's cumulative vector gets a long tail of flows from those disposal chains that no model omitting them can reach.
